method: Actual CUA browser screenshots captured while navigating and manipulating the working atlas. Edited state sequence with reading pauses and original score; not an uninterrupted screen recording.

frames.title: Matter becomes a device
frames.caption: Keep one specimen in view as growth and deposition change its material structure.

frames.title: Inspect the same structure
frames.caption: Dimensioned cross-sections and optional 3D inspection carry the same material identity.

frames.title: Measure before acceptance
frames.caption: A measurement and its uncertainty determine acceptance; geometry alone does not.

frames.title: A bit has a physical path
frames.caption: Decode an address and issue a read. Bank state determines the next command sequence.

frames.title: Count every layer
frames.caption: Twelve dies change capacity, stack height, interfaces and the thermal budget together.

frames.title: Watch computation unfold
frames.caption: Follow operands through a systolic wavefront and inspect each partial sum.

frames.title: One result. Four schedules.
frames.caption: Scalar, vector, SIMT and systolic schedules preserve the same exact matrix result.

frames.title: From intent to hardware
frames.caption: An arithmetic contract becomes RTL and a mapped netlist. A carry bit preserves 15 + 15.

frames.title: Inspect the actual artifact
frames.caption: Explore placed cells, routed resources and timing from a reproducible FPGA tool flow.

frames.title: Installed is only the start
frames.caption: Useful work requires power, cooling, data movement and commissioning to align.

frames.title: What survives a fault?
frames.caption: Uncheckpointed work is lost. Follow replay, retained steps and the energy ledger.

frames.title: Challenge what was learned
frames.caption: Training loss is only one signal. A broken correlation exposes two held-out errors.

frames.title: Evidence and correctness
frames.caption: A citation can be supported while the answer targets the wrong entity. Evaluate both.

frames.title: Computation beyond Earth
frames.caption: Power, battery, heat, storage and ground contacts constrain the same workload.

frames.title: Deliver the useful result
frames.caption: Retained onboard work and delivered products differ. Inspect the binding constraint.

frames.title: Trace each breakthrough
frames.caption: Connect a breakthrough to its mechanism, worked arithmetic and the next limiting step.

frames.title: Make the assumptions visible
frames.caption: Compare 3× compute versus 2× memory per two years as explicit conditional assumptions.

frames.title: Explore. Test. Understand.
frames.caption: Read capacity with its source date, physical boundary and operating status. Continue in the atlas.
